title: The Cutting Edge: Week of May 10th
body:
## **Highlights**
- Recording breaking AMA with[ [New-Futures](https://www.newfutures.network/)](https://zien.io/) got tremendous response from the community and became the longest AMA hosted on the Edgeware channel so far.
- [AllianceBlock](https://blog.edgewa.re/allianceblock-announces-decentralized-capital-market-on-edgeware-with-unique-defi-nft-approach/) is joining the Edgeware Ecosystem with their decentralized capital market, bringing NFT, DAO and Defi standards to WASM as well as EVM.
- Market Across’s [PR campaign](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Gk8LspTuCvtFb6WNLF3KJdun6HgS6WnN/view?usp=sharing) has been kicked off.
- Thom Ivy shared his [vision](https://twitter.com/thom_ivy_1/status/1391900642709544967?s=20) of various real-world use cases for EDG; [compendiously summarised](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1147-edgeware-as-an-auxiliary-network-state-a-community-token-for-social-goods) by Raymond Zhong.
- [Treasury Funding simplified](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1150-what-is-the-treasury-for-who-should-benefit-and-how): funding types and benefits’ hierarchy by Richard Welsh.
- Upcoming AMAs: [AllianceBlock](https://blog.edgewa.re/allianceblock-announces-decentralized-capital-market-on-edgeware-with-unique-defi-nft-approach/) and [Exit Theory](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1131-exit-theory-a-content-and-community-project).

## 
## **Ecosystem Updates**
No major updates this week, just building.

## **Governance**
- **Referendum 36:** Drew Stone proposed an increase in active validator slots from 110 to 120. {Referendum type: SuperMajorityApprove}
- **Referendum 37:** Raymond Zhong proposed [a minor patch upgrade](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1149-edgeware-runtime-upgrade-tokyo2) to resolve an issue identified by Wei. Advised to reject (aka vote ‘Nay’) as the same upgrade has been passed as an emergency referendum #38. {Referendum type: SuperMajorityApprove}
